title: Admin endpoint: GET /export/car?group=X&limit=N
description: Add GET /export/car?group=X&limit=N to the admin HTTP server. Returns binary CARv1 Content-Type: application/vnd.ipld.car; version=1. Extend start_admin_server() to accept Arc<dyn IpfsStore> and pass it through to handle_admin_connection(). Parse group from query params (reuse extract_query_param), validate it is a non-empty string, call build_export_car(), stream the bytes. limit defaults to 1000, max 10000.
